dependencies.reason: Supplies Client interface, domain data models, options configuration, forge detection, error hierarchy, and shared transport foundation that this adapter implements.
Shares the issuex package and NewWithOptions client factory dispatch logic, where NewGitLab is registered alongside NewGitHub.

tasks.title: Implement GitLab client constructor, transport, rate-limiting, error handling, and factory wiring
steps: Write unit tests TS-03-1, TS-03-2, TS-03-25, TS-03-26, TS-03-28, property tests TS-03-5, TS-03-27, and integration tests TS-03-3, TS-03-4 in issuex/gitlab_test.go; verify they fail.

In issuex/gitlab.go, define the unexported gitlabClient struct implementing issuex.Client with fields baseURL, token, userAgent, httpClient, repo, sleep func(time.Duration), mergeMethod string, and squashOption string.

Implement NewGitLab(o Options) (Client, error): resolve baseURL from o.BaseURL, GITLAB_API_URL, or default to https://gitlab.com/api/v4, trimming trailing slashes and appending /api/v4 when absent; resolve token from o.Token or GITLAB_TOKEN; set default 30-second timeout httpClient and userAgent to agent-fox; initialize sleep to time.Sleep.
Implement Authenticated() bool returning token != \"\" and Close() error calling CloseIdleConnections() on httpClient.Transport if supported and returning nil.

Implement host probe in issuex/factory.go: when NewWithOptions encounters an ambiguous host URL that does not match github or gitlab, issue GET /api/v4/version; if probe returns HTTP 200 with GitLab version payload, construct and return a GitLab client for that host.
Update NewWithOptions in issuex/factory.go: when o.NoOp is false and forge type is ForgeTypeGitLab, call NewGitLab(o) instead of returning ErrUnsupportedForge.

Implement (*gitlabClient).do(ctx, method, path, reqBody, respTarget): send Accept: application/json and User-Agent, append PRIVATE-TOKEN: <Token> when authenticated, and Content-Type: application/json when body is present. Read response body through io.LimitReader bounded to 8 MB.

Implement GitLab error payload parsing formatting message string, nested field validation object arrays (\"field: error\"), or error and error_description into HTTPError, wrapping ErrNotFound on 404 and ErrConflict on 405, 406, and 409.

Implement rate-limit backoff retry in do(): on HTTP 429, parse backoff via RetryAfter(); if <= 120s, invoke sleep and retry request once; if > 120s or retry fails, return error wrapping ErrRateLimited.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitLab_Client|TestGitLab_Constructor|TestGitLab_Factory|TestGitLab_Headers|TestGitLab_Transport' to confirm tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement URL-encoded project path routing, repository metadata inspection, and merge policy caching
steps: Write unit tests TS-03-7 and TS-03-8, and property test TS-03-6 in issuex/gitlab_test.go covering URL-encoded project paths, repository metadata, permissions calculation, merge settings, and authenticated vs unauthenticated 404 responses; verify they fail.
In issuex/gitlab.go, implement helper projectPath(repo Repo) string formatting url.PathEscape(repo.String()) with slashes replaced by %2F.
Implement GetRepository(ctx context.Context, repo Repo) (Repository, error) executing GET /projects/{project_path} using URL-encoded path.

Populate Repository struct with FullName from path_with_namespace, DefaultBranch, Private (true when visibility is private or internal), Archived, and Permissions calculated from effective access level: Pull if >= 20 or not private, Push if >= 30, and Admin if >= 40.
Record project merge settings merge_method and squash_option from the GitLab project response onto gitlabClient.
If GetRepository receives HTTP 404 on an unauthenticated client, wrap ErrNotFound with guidance indicating the project may be private and require GITLAB_TOKEN; if authenticated, return ErrNotFound.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitLab_Path|TestGitLab_GetRepository' to confirm tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement issue lifecycle, comment handling, and label operations
steps: Write unit tests TS-03-9, TS-03-10, TS-03-11, TS-03-12, TS-03-13, TS-03-14, TS-03-15, TS-03-16, and TS-03-17 in issuex/gitlab_issues_test.go; verify they fail.
In issuex/gitlab_issues.go, enforce unauthenticated mutation checks returning ErrNoToken for CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, CloseIssue, AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, and CreateLabel.

Implement CreateIssue(ctx, repo, req) executing POST /projects/{project_path}/issues with title, description, and comma-separated labels; return created Issue with Number: iid, normalized state open, and IsPR: false.

Implement ReadIssue(ctx, ref) executing GET /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} using ref.Number as iid; normalize state opened to open; set IsPR: false; call ListComments(ctx, ref). If comment fetching fails, record in IssueThread.CommentsErr without failing ReadIssue. On unauthenticated 404, annotate error with private issue guidance.
Implement UpdateIssue(ctx, ref, req) executing PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with non-empty fields and state_event (close or reopen), returning updated Issue.
Implement CloseIssue(ctx, ref, comment): if comment is non-empty, call AddComment first; then execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with state_event close.

Implement ListIssues(ctx, repo, filter) paginating GET /projects/{project_path}/issues with query parameters state (opened, closed, all), labels, assignee_username, order_by, sort, and per_page=100; set IssueList.Incomplete = true if limit is reached while additional issues remain.
Implement AddComment(ctx, ref, body) executing POST /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number}/notes with the comment body, returning note web_url or issue comment anchor URL.

Implement ListComments(ctx, ref) paginating GET /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number}/notes?per_page=100&page={page}&sort=asc&order_by=created_at, filtering out notes where system == true, iterating up to 5 pages (500 notes max), and setting CommentList.Truncated = true if cap is reached and more notes exist.

Implement AddLabels(ctx, ref, labels): if labels is empty, return nil immediately; otherwise execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with add_labels containing comma-separated label names.
Implement RemoveLabel(ctx, ref, label) executing PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with remove_labels, succeeding idempotently if label was not present.
Implement CreateLabel(ctx, repo, label) executing POST /projects/{project_path}/labels formatting color with leading #, treating HTTP 409 or HTTP 400 with already exists as nil success.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitLab_Issue.*|TestGitLab_Comment.*|TestGitLab_Label.*' to confirm tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement merge request lifecycle, diff inspection, CI checks, reviews, and merge execution
steps: Write unit tests TS-03-18, TS-03-19, TS-03-20, TS-03-21, TS-03-22, TS-03-23, and TS-03-24 in issuex/gitlab_mr_test.go; verify they fail.
In issuex/gitlab_mr.go, enforce unauthenticated mutation checks returning ErrNoToken for CreatePullRequest, ClosePullRequest, PostReviewComment, and MergePullRequest.

Implement CreatePullRequest(ctx, repo, req): prefix title with Draft: if req.Draft is true and prefix is missing; execute POST /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests with source_branch, target_branch, title, and description; return PullRequest with Number: iid, normalized open state, and Merged: false.

Implement ReadPullRequest(ctx, ref) executing GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}; parse state (opened to open, merged to merged), Draft: (draft || work_in_progress), HeadBranch, BaseBranch, HeadSHA, and author; on unauthenticated 404, annotate error with private repository guidance.

Implement ReadChangedFiles(ctx, ref) executing GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/changes; for each change, map Filename from new_path or old_path, Status (added, deleted, modified), and count diff lines starting with + or - (excluding +++ and ---) to populate Additions and Deletions.
Implement GetPRState(ctx, ref) executing GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}, returning PRState with Number: iid, State, Merged, and HeadSHA.
Implement ClosePullRequest(ctx, ref) executing PUT /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number} with state_event close.

Implement GetCIChecks(ctx, ref) executing GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/pipelines?per_page=1; if no pipelines, return []CheckRun{} and nil; query GET /projects/{project_path}/pipelines/{id}/jobs?per_page=100 and map jobs to CheckRun with normalized status and conclusion.

Implement GetPRReviews(ctx, ref) querying approvals via GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/approvals (mapping approved_by to Review with State: approved) and discussion notes via GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/notes (filtering system == false to State: commented), returning combined slice sorted chronologically.
Implement PostReviewComment(ctx, ref, body) executing POST /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/notes with the comment body.

Implement MergePullRequest(ctx, ref, opts): build payload with commit_message, sha if specified, and squash boolean (governed by opts.Method: true for MergeMethodSquash, false for MergeMethodMerge, omitted for MergeMethodDefault); execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/merge; map HTTP 405, 406, and 409 to ErrConflict; return MergeResult on HTTP 200.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitLab_MR.*|TestGitLab_Merge.*|TestGitLab_CI.*|TestGitLab_Review.*' to confirm tests pass.

tasks.title: Verify GitLab adapter execution paths, contracts, and ambiguous host probe end-to-end
steps: Write smoke tests TS-03-29, TS-03-30, TS-03-31, and TS-03-32 in issuex/gitlab_smoke_test.go exercising the live execution paths against mock HTTP server environments.

Trace 03-PATH-1 through NewGitLab, CreateIssue, ReadIssue (verifying issue thread and filtered comments), and CloseIssue (verifying comment posting and closed state); confirm each step transitions to the next with zero stubs.

Trace 03-PATH-2 through NewWithOptions with GitLab remote URL, ReadPullRequest, GetCIChecks (verifying pipeline job mapping), PostReviewComment, and MergePullRequest with MergeMethodDefault; confirm each call transitions to the next with zero stubs.
Trace 03-PATH-3 through rate-limit backoff retry with injected sleep function verifying that HTTP 429 with 2-second Retry-After sleeps and retries successfully; confirm execution flow.

Trace 03-PATH-4 through NewWithOptions probing an ambiguous host via GET /api/v4/version, constructing the GitLab client, and calling GetRepository using URL-encoded project path; confirm execution flow.

Confirm every unwanted criterion contract is satisfied in production code: IsNotFound on 404 with private guidance, IsNoToken on unauthenticated writes, IsConflict on merge 405/406/409, IsRateLimited on excessive backoff or retry failure, and partial comment error preservation in IssueThread.CommentsErr.

Search all touched files (issuex/gitlab.go, issuex/factory.go, issuex/gitlab_issues.go, issuex/gitlab_mr.go, issuex/gitlab_test.go, issuex/gitlab_issues_test.go, issuex/gitlab_mr_test.go, issuex/gitlab_smoke_test.go) for stub markers like panic(\"not implemented\"), TODO, or unimplemented return values, and ensure none remain.
Run make test and make lint to verify the full repository build, lint, and test suite pass cleanly.
done_when: `make test` passes with zero failures across all packages
`make lint` passes with no formatting or vet discrepancies
